class_default: LO206 Junior @ Mosport / MIKA (path to BSC Ontario)

product_rules.one_change_note: One CATEGORY per outing (gearing OR clutch OR tires OR chassis). Within that category, magnitude follows best practice + data (gear may be +1 or +2+). Do not stack categories same outing.

ingest.note_xrz: AiM: .xrz compresses one .xrk for faster transfer

priority.role: peaks, exit floors, limiter flats, clutch flare
pair with RPM for gear + clutch; better than GPS
separate timid throttle from tall gear

channels.rule_rpm_plus_speed: Never diagnose clutch or gearing from RPM alone; always pair with speed.

class_defaults.power_band_junior_note: Restricted slides peak earlier than stock. Klaus: unrestricted peak HP ~5600; Green slide peak ~4800 — gearing past ~5300 can be slower. Yellow .570 sits between stock and green — confirm dyno; prefer strong mid-band exits over limiter ego.
class_defaults.min_weight_verify: Confirm current MIKA Class Structure — do not assume 300 lb without PDF

qualitative_bands.exit_rpm_low: Exit RPM clearly below usable band for this slide (Junior: below strong mid-band; do not use Green numbers as Yellow truth)
qualitative_bands.exit_rpm_ok: Exit RPM inside usable band while speed still soft vs reference
qualitative_bands.peak_on_limiter_early: RPM flat at ~6100 with track still left on longest straight in solo running
qualitative_bands.peak_never_near_band_top: Peaks well below band top every lap solo
qualitative_bands.clutch_late_slip: RPM flares while speed lags on launch or slow-corner exit
qualitative_bands.clutch_early_bite: RPM drops hard as clutch grabs; boggy; engagement below target
qualitative_bands.hot_psi_high: Hot pressures above compound window; greasy/'on ice' late
qualitative_bands.hot_psi_low: Hot pressures below window; heavy/won't rotate
qualitative_bands.numbers_policy: Only cite numeric thresholds when sourced (Swift/Klaus/Hilliard). Otherwise use qualitative bands + user-logged baselines.

signal_to_action.one_change: Add N rear teeth per RPM+speed / exit analysis (often 1; use 2+ when toothDelta/best practice supports); re-log same corner
signal_to_action.confidence_hint: high if repeated across clean laps

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Line / confidence / balance — not first a shorter gear
signal_to_action.one_change: One drill (later turn-in/width) OR one chassis spacer — not both; do not add short gear yet
signal_to_action.confidence_hint: medium — needs notes or video for chassis vs driving

signal_to_action.one_change: Remove N rear teeth per RPM+speed analysis (often 1; use 2+ when toothDelta/best practice supports)
Rule out brake drag/chain/bind (Klaus #12) before gear_plus_one

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Geared for limiter ego instead of restricted-slide peak
signal_to_action.one_change: Lengthen one tooth; re-check exit floors stay in strong mid-band

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Power / drag / gear / load — not classic clutch slip
signal_to_action.one_change: Check throttle opening, brake drag, gearing, load before clutch springs

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Float / fuel delivery / heat path (high level)
signal_to_action.one_change: Verify float height per Briggs carb guide; no illegal jet changes

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Tire wear/glaze makes ratio behave too long
signal_to_action.one_change: Add 1 rear tooth for next segment OR verify hot tire pressures first if greasy
Lower next cold start 0.5–2 PSI toward hot target; confirm series tire
Raise next cold start slightly; re-measure hot within ~60s pit-in
One pressure step OR consistency drill — not both
Widen front one spacer step OR +caster per chassis chart — one only

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Too much rear grip / unload issue
signal_to_action.one_change: Narrow rear slightly OR small seat/ballast stability move — one only

signal_to_action.hypothesis: Split: low exit RPM → S1; RPM OK → driving line
signal_to_action.one_change: Apply S1 or S2 rule; Mosport overlay prioritizes exit
Bigger pair for flowing; smaller for tight — keep same ratio first

restricted_slide_gearing.action: Gear for yellow-slide mid-band peak, not 6100 ego

tire_pressure_session.action: Cold→hot methodology; confirm series tire; no invented Mosport PSI

sourced_hot_window_hard_compound_illustr.note: Swift illustrative for many hard compounds — NOT Mosport Junior fact

tire_pressure_session.mosport_junior_psi: UNKNOWN — confirm series tire + MIKA/BSC bulletin

chassis_before_engine.action: Systematic bind/drag/kerb/alignment check before engine blame

chassis_front_wider.action: Widen front track one spacer step

carb_float_check.action: Verify float per Briggs carb guide; jets stay stock/legal

sprocket_pair_inertia.action: Change sprocket pair size at same ratio

gear_ratio_optimize.action: Use peak+exit RPM routine to pick ±1 tooth

gear_plus_rear.action: Add N rear teeth per RPM+speed / exit analysis (often 1; use 2+ when toothDelta/best practice supports)
gear_plus_rear.when: S1, S11, optionally after S4 drag ruled out

gear_minus_rear.action: Remove N rear teeth per RPM+speed analysis (often 1; use 2+ when toothDelta/best practice supports)
gear_minus_rear.when: S3; front-row/long-main tire save per Swift

steps: Pick the single highest-confidence setup CATEGORY (gearing / clutch / tires / chassis) from largest delta loss
Within that category apply data-backed magnitude (gear: +1 or +2+ rear teeth per toothDelta / RPM+speed math — no forced ±1 cap)
Emit one setup-tagged action only for that category
Optional separate driving drill if S2 — never bundled as same physical change
Queue next CATEGORY only after evidence
forbid: Stacking categories same outing (gear + clutch springs)
Forcing only 1 tooth when toothDelta/best practice supports 2+

mosport_junior_overlays.priority_corners: Hairpin / T5-type exits (exit RPM + min speed); bowl/linked for scrub consistency
mosport_junior_overlays.weight: Verify MIKA (~300 lb national chart typical)
